text:
Javier: Quick sync — Zephyr wants a 4-week POC to validate LLM routing + invoice redaction and to measure cost/latency tradeoffs. They asked for a POC scope, success criteria, pricing estimate, and security artifacts (DPA, SOC2 report, pen-test). Can we align today?
Priya: +1. Need concrete success metrics from them. Suggested minimums: latency p95 < 300ms for small prompts, redaction F1 > 0.95 on sample labeled set, and end-to-end throughput target (requests/sec). Also need sample prompts + 2000 anonymized invoices for evals.
Javier: They already sent 500 real invoices (PII redacted on their side) and can deliver 2k by EOW. Timeline they want: kickoff next Monday, 2 weeks for integration & baseline, 2 weeks for optimization/hand-off. Is that realistic?
Priya: Yes, that timeline is doable for hosted POC. Plan: week1 ingest + integration, week2 run baseline evals, week3 optimizations (batching, quantization suggestions), week4 validation + handoff. We'll produce an eval report with prompt-level failure cases.
Liam: Heads up — security asks: 1) Do we treat incoming sample invoices as PHI? 2) They requested our DPA and SOC2 Type II artifacts. 3) They asked if they can run a pen-test against the POC endpoint.
Nadia: We can share the standard DPA and a redacted SOC2 Type II report (control summary + auditor letter). We need to confirm customer info before full SOC2 disclosure. For PHI/HIPAA: we can negotiate a BAA if the workload requires PHI handling.
Javier: They say some invoices may contain health plan references (low chance) — so better assume HIPAA could apply. What's the process for BAA?
Nadia: We can negotiate a BAA. For POC we typically include data handling clauses in the DPA plus a BAA addendum when PHI is in scope. Also require minimal retention — we can commit to deletion after POC and share deletion confirmation.
Liam: On pen-tests: hosted endpoints have limited pen-test windows. Typical approach: for hosted POC we allow non-intrusive, pre-approved scans only (OWASP top 10 / network scans excluded). For deeper tests (active exploitation, simulated attacks) we require a Dedicated or Private deployment and a formal scoping call. If they insist on pen-test, ask what type: black-box, white-box, internal network?
Priya: If they can accept hosted constraints, we can offer an approved scanner list and a 4-hour test window after we snapshot the environment. For Dedicated, we can coordinate with eng-sre for a full 2-week test window with IP allowlist.
Javier: Pricing question: They asked if POC is free and whether dedicated hours cost extra. What's standard?
Priya: We provide a credit-backed hosted POC (credits for tokens + 5 hours of SE time included). Dedicated capacity or longer heavy-load benchmarks will require an uplift or short-term commit. I'll prepare a simple estimate: hosted POC = covered by credits; Dedicated POC = monthly reserved price prorated + infra surcharge.
Liam: Also need to capture compliance controls for their security questionnaire. I'll prep an answers doc: DPA status, SOC2 availability (redacted), encryption at rest/in transit (AES-256/TLS1.2+), KMS support (customer-managed keys on Private), logging retention, and data deletion commitments. Need their questionnaire early — send as a spreadsheet.
Javier: I'll request their security questionnaire now. Priya — can you draft the POC success criteria + minimal test plan I can send to them?
Priya: Yup. Draft plan items: - Goals: verify redaction accuracy + routing correctness - Metrics: redaction F1 >= 0.95, latency p95 < 300ms, error rate < 0.5% - Inputs: 2k invoices (anonymized), 30 sample prompts for edge cases - Deliverables: eval report, Cost/latency spreadsheet, runbook for production rollout - Exit criteria: pass metrics + signoff from Zephyr eng and security
Nadia: Add legal items: signed DPA (and BAA if PHI), NDA for SOW details if requested, and explicit deletion confirmation + audit log export request handling.
Javier: They also asked for a short sample prompt for replication. Priya — example?
Priya: Example prompt (edge case):
```
System: You are an invoice-parsing assistant. Extract vendor, invoice_date, total_amount, and redact any personal identifiers (SSN, DOB, account numbers).
User: <raw invoice text>
```
Priya: We'll run this prompt set through our eval harness and provide precision/recall per field.
Liam: Action items for security: 1) Javier send questionnaire (ASAP). 2) Liam to return preliminary answers + SOC2 redacted within 48h. 3) Confirm HIPAA scope — if yes, Nadia to trigger BAA template.
Nadia: I'll prep the DPA + BAA template and share with Javier for signature. Expect draft in 24–48h.
Priya: SE action items: request sample dataset (S3 link or secure upload), confirm API keys, and agree on test windows for any scans.
Javier: I'll schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow (invite sent). Zephyr is keen to start next Monday. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: Notice: kickoff-meeting scheduled by Javier for 2025-04-07 15:00 UTC. :calendar: 
Javier: Perfect — we'll walk through integration steps and security expectations in that call. :thumbsup:
